messages:
Maria: Sofa + lamp cleanup — giving away IKEA Karlstad 3-seat (dark gray) + vintage brass desk lamp (works). No tears. 76" sofa, fits through a standard door. Can deliver SF downtown if you're around today. Pics: https://imgur.com/abc123 :sofa:
Tyler: oh sweet. how deep is the sofa? couch depth matters for my tiny apt.
Maria: Depth is 38in, seat depth ~22in. Cushions still firm. here's a closeup of fabric: https://imgur.com/def456
Eshan: Is delivery free? I'm on Folsom St — can you bring it upstairs?
Maria: I can carry to street level and help load, but no stairs inside building. Delivery included within 10mi radius. DM for address.
Jules: Any stains? also lamp bulb type?
Maria: No stains. Slipcovers removed and laundered yesterday. Lamp uses E26 bulb, shade has tiny dent (pic in album).
Tyler: I can pick up today around 6pm and take both. I'll send a DM to confirm.
Eshan: If Tyler flakes, I'm next in line. +1 for the lamp.
GiveawayBot: :tada: Congrats to @Tyler! Please confirm pickup window within 30 mins or we'll move to next.
Maria: Confirmed with Tyler in DM. Thanks everyone! If plans change I'll post here.
